original_text: As a Backend Systems Developer, I want a distributed cron execution matrix to trigger clean-up tasks during low-load hours. Architecture Logic: The microservice worker coordinates data storage compression routines. Das Hintergrund-Task-Management-System laeuft vollstaendig asynchron. Der Scheduler startet den Bereinigungsprozess jede Nacht um 02:00 Uhr: Loesche temporaere Tabellen. Optimiere Datenbankindizes. Bereinige abgelaufene Benutzersitzungen. If an exception occurs during execution, the worker writes the complete stack trace to the centralized monitoring platform and retries the task up to three times.
